business_problem: BSH needed to make its Home Connect platform more agile and scalable while gaining better customer insight so it could support growing smart-home usage and focus more on customer relationships.
solution_summary: BSH migrated Home Connect to AWS to give its connected-home platform the scale and agility required for a growing appliance ecosystem. Customer-facing workloads run on Amazon EC2, while usage and platform data can be stored and analyzed through Amazon S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon Redshift to support business insight and service improvement. AWS KMS and AWS CloudTrail add security and audit controls suitable for a customer-centric digital platform. By moving Home Connect to AWS, BSH shifted from managing fixed infrastructure to operating a cloud-backed environment that can scale with user demand, support faster change, and create a better data foundation for understanding how customers use connected appliances. The migration also gives the company more room to prioritize relationship-building and service innovation rather than platform constraints.
